title: Commercial Loan Sub-Servicing for Credit Funds & Banks | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Institutional commercial loan sub-servicing for CRE and business loan portfolios — ACH collection, lender disbursement, delinquency tracking, and audit trails.
h1: Commercial loan sub-servicing built for institutional books
lede: Credit funds and banks often inherit a patchwork: one ledger, another collections vendor, insurance in email. Sub-servicing should be one operating layer — for commercial real estate and business loans only.

sections.heading: Who this is for
paragraphs: Portfolio managers, chief credit officers, and operations leads at credit funds, community banks, specialty lenders, and capital platforms who need a B2B sub-servicer — not a residential mortgage shop.

sections.heading: What sub-servicing includes
paragraphs: Borrower payment collection via ACH, scheduled lender disbursement with reconcilable trails, statement cycles, delinquency monitoring, and escalation into workout when accounts break covenant or payment terms.

sections.heading: Why institutions switch
paragraphs: Handoffs between tools create blind spots. Examiners and LPs ask for the audit trail. A single servicing matrix shortens time-to-signal when a loan goes off-plan.

faqs.a: No. Veteran Loan Servicing services commercial real estate and business/commercial loans only. We do not service consumer residential mortgages.
Borrower payments are collected via ACH and disbursed to lenders on a scheduled monthly cycle structured around NACHA operating guidelines, with a full audit trail.

faqs.q: Can you migrate an existing book?
faqs.a: Yes. Engagements start with portfolio review and ledger migration with reconciliation before go-live.

ctaBody: Request a platform demo tailored to your CRE or business loan portfolio.
